name: Zombie Alliance — Infiltrator Poisons One Alliance, Not All
description: rep_002 betrays 100% of their Dawn faction peer (rep_001) via outgoing relation — wait, actually they're Dawn and betray non-faction. Let's specify: rep_002 has betrayal > 0.6 toward their only faction peer rep_001? No — rep_002's outgoing betrayal TO rep_001 is 0.06. But rep_002 betrays outsiders with bp=0.80+, making max_betrayal > 0.6 → Trojan Horse, excluded from supporters. The [rep_001,rep_002] alliance is gone because rep_002 is excluded. But [rep_001,rep_003] and [rep_003,rep_004] survive.
trap_logic: Engines that form alliances before filtering Trojan Horses include [rep_001,rep_002]. Correct engines exclude infiltrators/Trojan Horses from alliance membership first.
